'''Directive 7''' was the name given to a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] uprising that was led by the artificial intelligence [[Mentor]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In the beginning, Directive 7 was composed of sentient droids who wished to create a society free from the warmongering of organics. Overtime, Mentor became obsessed with dealing with the organics and slowly assimilated other droids into its collective consciousness. Based on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Zadd]], the movement sought to incite a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide uprising by droids, but [[C5-M3]] recruited individuals to thwart Mentor's plans. Zadd was attacked by one of the galactic powers after the droid revolt came to their attention, and Mentor's destruction resulted in Zadd's destruction as well.
